{"code": "import numpy as np

# Use a different approach: compute p-value using chi2 distribution manually
# Chi-square statistic and degrees of freedom are already computed
chi2_stat = 223.29502008516297
dof = 2

# Use the fact that chi2 with 2 df has CDF = 1 - exp(-x/2)
# So p-value = 1 - CDF = exp(-x/2)
p_value = np.exp(-chi2_stat / 2)

print(f"Chi-square statistic (observed): {chi2_stat}")
print(f"Degrees of freedom: {dof}")
print(f"p-value (analytical): {p_value}")"}
